criteria.assessment: Approved for the assigned WB-002 source/inventory slice: local current/task/archive/gitless attribution, pinned full-commit requested bytes, explicit refresh semantics, safe missing-source diagnostics and noneditable committed snapshots. The prior external .later root read is now rejected before enumeration and has a discriminating retained regression. UI navigation and full source admission remain subsequent tasks.

unit.assessment: WB-source-errors asserts traversal rejection, missing blob/model diagnostics and committed outside-symlink exclusion. The independently checked root-directory-symlink remediation in inventory complements these safe-source assertions.

integration.assessment: WB-inventory covers current/task ref, archive/missing-model discovery, parked-card separation, detached/gitless explanations and a symlinked .later root. WB-snapshot binds all requested bytes to one resolved commit and preserves the old capture after explicit refresh. Independent instrumented reproduction confirms no unsafe directory enumeration/content read and unchanged HEAD/refs.

tests.assertion_assessment: Retained assertions cover task-branch current work, local live/archive inventory, missing models, parked-card separation, detached context and gitless fallback. The added external .later directory symlink fixture now requires an empty parked-card result, discriminating the exact previously rejected content/source-attribution bug. Independent wrappers additionally observed no enumeration or content read through that symlink.
tests.counterexample: The pre-fix implementation returns the external private.md heading as a local parked card. New regression at 019dad0322154e4eeb028c8b1935b02f9b593ac4 fails by behavior assertion on that result; the candidate returns before iterdir and does not read the external heading.

Remediation red b8eabe0b113c4923a40aa8a7e8d364a0 fails WB-inventory on the exact ancestor-symlink finding with collection_status=ok and failure_kind=behavior_assertion. Repair-red test bytes match final candidate source; final-green 16738323cd53448d9dc1c0659a589956 passes all three cases. No exemption.

tests.assertion_assessment: Assertions bind model, graph, plan and requested source to the first captured full commit, preserve the captured bytes after ref movement, permit a new snapshot only on explicit reread, and expose editable=false. The implementation uses read-only Git commands and no publication/edit path.
tests.counterexample: A reader that resolves the moving ref independently for each blob can mix revision 1 model and revision 2 source; a refreshed read that mutates the original capture fails the retained REVISION=1 assertion. The test could be strengthened by capturing HEAD/refs/files before the initial read instead of afterward.

limitations: SourceSnapshot is a raw committed byte container, not a validated Engineering Model admission. Downstream selected-source validation must use the existing document layer before consumption; editable=false does not establish validation.
No coordinator recording or integration was performed.

resolved_findings.assessment: A symlinked .later root returns no cards before directory enumeration. New regression and independent instrumented reproduction establish no external content read; original rejected artifact remains preserved.
